About Tessera

Tessera is an AI platform that drives business transformation and unlocks new value for enterprises. The Platform's agents deliver governed execution across ERP, CRM, HCM and finance systems, cutting timelines from years to weeks and costs by more than half.

Role Summary

We are seeking a senior SAP MM Consultant to own materials management and its data on SAP S/4HANA migrations and data harmonisation: the material master, purchasing, inventory and the open documents that run them. You own the target design, the MM data migration from mapping to cutover, and the proof that it works after the load. This is a doer role, not an advisory one.

How the Work Is Different

Tessera is a software company, not a services firm: we do not sell hours, and the Platform's AI agents do the heavy lifting — process analysis, data profiling, conversion and validation. You bring the SAP judgment: you specify the work, check what comes back against SAP models, tables and real data, and own the calls a client signs.

Our success measure is the client's adoption of the Platform. A consultant leaves and takes the capability with them; when you leave, the capability stays with the client. That is why we hire SMEs on a path to become Forward Deployed Engineers, one of the most sought-after roles in tech, with Platform certification and support from our FDE team along the way.

Key Responsibilities

1. Materials and procurement design. Own the material master design — views, plant and storage data, MRP data, units of measure — and the interfaces with plant maintenance, projects and finance. Work through the MM simplification items and use fit-to-standard to decide what to keep, change or retire.

2. MM data migration ownership. Own the MM data migration workstream end to end: object scope, source-to-target field mapping, value mapping and transformation rules, load order and sign-off criteria. Keep the mapping document as the system of record for every mapping decision, and track each open point from workshop to closure.

3. Mock loads, validation and reconciliation. Run iterative mock loads and dress rehearsals. Pilot on a selective test batch before full loads. Read the load logs and classify each failure as a data defect, a mapping defect, a configuration gap or a tooling issue. Check units of measure, material types, valuation classes, blanks and duplicates before each load, and show a reconciliation after it: record counts, field-level samples and checks in target transactions.

4. Cutover and hypercare. Set the open PO and requisition cut-off rules, the inventory freeze and the load timing for cutover. Support dress rehearsals and production loads, and own data issues in your object scope during hypercare.

5. Client engagement. Lead mapping workshops with business data owners and drive each issue to sign-off, on several engagements at once, with clear written handoffs.

6. AI agents and adoption. Set the requirements and acceptance criteria the agents work to, act as the final quality gate on their output, turn findings into reusable rules, and enable the client's team to run the Platform on their own.

Data Objects in Scope

You own the functional design, mapping, validation and sign-off for MM data objects. The core objects cover the procure-to-pay chain: material master, suppliers, purchasing master data, requisitions and agreements, purchase orders, and goods receipts and invoices. Inventory, valuation, classification and batches are desired. Maintenance, project and service procurement and supplier EDI set you apart.

Technical & Functional Skills

Material master: material types, views and organisational levels, field selection, units of measure and conversions, valuation classes, MRP data and classification.

Purchasing: requisitions and purchase orders, account assignment categories, info records, source lists, contracts and scheduling agreements, release strategies and pricing in purchasing.

Inventory management and valuation: goods movements and movement types, stock types, physical inventory, price control and valuation areas, posting period dependencies, and the SAP S/4HANA inventory data model (MATDOC).

Invoice verification and integration: logistics invoice verification, GR/IR clearing, account determination for inventory postings, and integration with FI, CO, PM, PS and SD.

Business Partner and CVI: supplier conversion to Business Partner through CVI — BP roles and groupings, number ranges, field mapping, the CVI Cockpit and synchronisation, the usual tax and bank data errors, and their impact on procure-to-pay.

Data migration: field and value mapping, SAP S/4HANA Migration Cockpit (staging tables), BAPI and IDoc-based loads, load order driven by master data dependencies, error-log analysis, validation before the load, and a reconciliation you can show — including mapping from Oracle or another ERP where fields have no direct target.

Client-facing: run workshops with procurement, inventory, maintenance and plant owners; present design decisions, trade-offs and risks to business and technical stakeholders; hold the scope boundary and say no in a way that keeps the relationship; get decisions recorded and signed off.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years in SAP MM configuration, used in the last 2 to 3 years.

  • 2+ full data migration lifecycles to SAP S/4HANA (from SAP ECC, Oracle or another ERP) with functional ownership of MM data objects — mapping, validation and sign-off, not only process or configuration roles.

  • Several mock loads or dress rehearsals, with data defects resolved across cycles, and at least one production cutover.

  • Hands-on CVI: supplier conversion to Business Partner on at least one SAP ECC to SAP S/4HANA migration.

  • A CV with named engagements: client, year and your own deliverable.

  • One concrete case of AI or automation in your own SAP work: the task, the tool and the result. Drafting documents with a chatbot does not count.

  • Experience delivering to large enterprise clients in a distributed team, with strong written discipline.

  • Based in the United States.

  • Fluent English.

  • Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Maintenance and project procurement: MRO and spare parts, reservations, and MM–PM and MM–PS integration.

  • Experience in utilities or another asset-intensive industry.

  • Migration and cleansing tools such as SAP Data Services, Syniti or SNP.

  • SQL or basic ABAP literacy, to run reconciliation queries and read table structures.

  • SAP MDG for supplier and material data.

  • Central procurement on SAP S/4HANA.

  • More than one SAP S/4HANA transition path: greenfield, brownfield or selective data transition.

  • Work in regulated or audit-heavy environments (SOX).

  • SAP S/4HANA Sourcing and Procurement certification.

No third party may recruit, solicit candidates, publish job opportunities, use Tessera Labs' name or branding, or represent that they are acting on behalf of Tessera Labs without prior written authorization. Any such activity conducted without explicit written consent is strictly prohibited.
